arguments.sql:
SELECT g.gender,
       a.alignment,
       COUNT(*) AS character_count,
       COUNT(s.weight_kg) AS non_null_weights,
       MIN(s.weight_kg) AS min_weight,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_weights,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_weights,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND typeof(s.weight_kg) NOT IN ('integer', 'real') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_numeric_weights
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
GROUP BY g.gender, a.alignment
ORDER BY g.gender, a.alignment

arguments.sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name, s.full_name, s.height_cm, s.weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND (s.weight_kg = 0 OR s.weight_kg IS NULL)
ORDER BY s.weight_kg, s.superhero_name
